verdict.rationale: Kushki documents API-driven flows for the core payment lifecycle: card charges, direct charges without a token, authorization and capture, voids and refunds, a 100% API 3DS integration, recurring and scheduled charges, and Webpay OneClick. Its site also markets multiple payment methods through one API. However, nothing in the pack claims or shows parity with the dashboard UI, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found (all candidate paths returned 404). Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, evidence that dashboard functions (Smartlink creation, payouts, reporting, account and settings management) are exposed via API, and a published OpenAPI spec or independent corroboration.
